art.title: St. Lawrence
art.why: Lawrence the deacon in clergy robes with his gridiron and a book: the Roman deacon remembered for giving the Church's goods to the poor (the story itself is in our own words; the painting shows only the saint and his attributes).
No free Roman official: Bellini's Scipio episode was claimed by honour-duty-service.
Peter and Paul together: Domenico di Bartolo's Madonna with Saints Peter and Paul has no gallery description, so cannot be described.
Early church: Saenredam's Santa Maria della Febbre was claimed by defence-of-the-west; Codazzi's Basilica of Constantine has no gallery description.

music.why: The ancient hymn to the Spirit promised in Acts 1:8.
Mendelssohn's oratorio of a prophet: there is no St Paul in music.json; add Mendelssohn's Paulus with a verified Spotify id if wanted.
'All creatures of our God and King': the message reaching every people. (Spec gave for-all-the-saints, which is also session 7.)
Where love is, God is: the meal and the care they were known for.
A hymn for light in the dark, sung before dawn as Pliny's Christians sang.
